summary: Issue #389 (RF-GPUI-06) Parent Lease migration slice: remove GuiParentToken from the public plugin/host/wire surface, introduce generation-bound opaque ParentLease{generation:u32,payload:u64}. Scope: plugin-core/plugin-host/plugin-vst3/plugin-clap/poc-native-dock/ui-gpui docs only; session state machine untouched. OS: Windows 11 x86_64, mise-managed toolchain

Design decision D2: GuiParentToken fully removed rather than retained — every use site sits inside the editable scope and plugin-export forwards `parent` opaquely, so the raw-token vocabulary leaves the public API entirely. ParentSlotLease stays the session-side vocabulary; LeaseRedeemer now yields ParentLease

WIRE_VERSION bumped 4 -> 5: wire codec policy requires a version bump on payload field-set changes (OpenGui parent u64 -> u32 generation + u64 payload). L1 GUI remains unimplemented so no live consumer is affected; host and runner ship the same workspace revision

poc-native-dock redeemers mint ParentLease::new(SlotLease::new(lease.raw()).seq(), token): the ParentSlotLease payload is the packed SlotLease {index,seq}, so generation is recovered issuer-side without changing ParentSlotLease's opaque u64 shape

Verification (mise tasks, Windows 11 x86_64): fmt-check PASS; check PASS for plugin-core/plugin-host/plugin-vst3(host)/plugin-clap(host)/poc-native-dock/ui-gpui/plugin-export/plugin-ofx/audio-plugin-bridge; lint -D warnings PASS for the six changed crates; test PASS plugin-core(126), plugin-host(226+49+187), plugin-vst3(host, 74+2, 3 real-adapter e2e ignored), plugin-clap(host), plugin-export(53), poc-native-dock(0). grep GuiParentToken crates/ = 0 hits
